basis: finding 1: a subgroup defined by sessions attended, which only coached seekers have
finding 2: one cell chosen as the largest of 60 searched, estimated on the same seekers
finding 3: keeping cells by p < 0.05 out of 60 tests, and reading the rest as no effect
finding 4: predicted and observed effects compared on the seekers the model was fitted to

memo.evidence: attenders' motivation 3.42 against 2.50 before the lottery
memo.effect: the 27-point claim mixes coaching with motivation; the randomised effect is 11 points

memo.fault: discovery and evaluation on the same data
memo.evidence: the top five cells of an honest search fall from 23 to 12 points on fresh seekers; the analyst's cell truly gains 10
memo.effect: the 50-point cell is mostly the noise that made it win the search

memo.fault: multiplicity, and no significance read as no effect
memo.evidence: 2 cells survive Bonferroni; 'no effect' cells truly gain 11 points
memo.effect: the target list is largely chance, and the excluded cells would benefit

memo.evidence: decile correlation 0.99 in sample, 0.81 held out
memo.effect: the agreement shown is the model's fit to its own data, not evidence that it ranks new seekers
